_note: Director layer per shot (authored from image + prompt). The measured layer (planes, depth, parallax) comes from multiplane.py. 'hero' names the label that should own Plane 2; 'camera' overrides the auto camera choice; keys = [id, pose/event, frames]. Durations at 24 fps; drawings on twos unless noted.

d3d25411-5610-40fd-ad76-e36a25eca80c_1.title: Naraka — the shadow-pool ritual
d3d25411-5610-40fd-ad76-e36a25eca80c_1.action: Kids crouched at the shadow-pool's edge drag their toes through the water; a glyph ripples outward, and the market light beyond the stairs flickers in answer — they look up.
keys: kids crouched, toes hovering (moving hold, breathing)
anticipation — knee pulls back, shoulders lift
toe drags a stroke, water parts (contact)
glyph complete — hold, ripple ring leaves
light on the stairs flickers (FX accent)
heads turn up toward the stairs (head leads, shoulders follow)

camera.why: the corridor converges on the lit stairs; pushing in moves us from the ritual toward the market that answers it

secondary: adults in P3 shift weight, one turns
drips fall from container eaves on 8s
d3d25411-5610-40fd-ad76-e36a25eca80c_1.staging: Keep kids small against the huge ceiling slab: the P0 overhang is the 'threshold'. Ripples must cross the P1 water strip toward camera.

3a0da51b-4c03-45a0-bf3f-d03e5092c4be_0.title: The Orange Catwalk — walkers into the haze
3a0da51b-4c03-45a0-bf3f-d03e5092c4be_0.action: Three walkers advance into the orange haze; the ceiling lights ahead ignite one by one with their steps, and the last walker pauses, glances back at us, then goes on.
keys: rear walker slows — passing pose held a beat
head turns back over shoulder (eyes lead)

camera.why: slow follow-push keeps distance constant but deepens the haze sheets; the ceiling P0 slides off-frame top

secondary: canal reflection on the left shimmers
distant figures (P4) fade in and out
3a0da51b-4c03-45a0-bf3f-d03e5092c4be_0.staging: Silhouettes must stay separated (no overlapping legs) — the three are the whole story. Ceiling slab and right wall are the camera mask.

3603f621-18f4-4711-ab93-946cab123329_0.title: Hive — the drum answers the tower
3603f621-18f4-4711-ab93-946cab123329_0.action: An empty drum circle under the signal towers; a drum is struck off-screen, a beacon pulse climbs the far tower, and the sky blushes red in reply.
keys: drum skin shivers (tiny secondary on P1)

camera.why: the camera follows the pulse up the tower — the movement reveals that the sky is the answer

secondary: near lattice towers' lamps flicker out of sync
3603f621-18f4-4711-ab93-946cab123329_0.staging: No character on screen: the tower is the performer. Near lattice frames (P0) bracket the stage like proscenium wings.

e9c68c53-270a-40d3-be47-b19b47b4068c_0.title: Ankhu — wind down the laundry line
e9c68c53-270a-40d3-be47-b19b47b4068c_0.action: A gust rolls down the laundry line; sarongs lift in sequence like a wave, uncovering the star cluster behind them, then settle.
keys: far sheets begin to lift (wave front)
mid-line sheets at extreme, far sheets dropping (overlap)
near sarong at full extreme — stars revealed

camera.why: a lateral truck makes the laundry lines (P0/P2) slide past the static star field and sells the rooftop's depth

secondary: tree on the left sways with a 4-frame delay
e9c68c53-270a-40d3-be47-b19b47b4068c_0.staging: The wave must travel along the line's arc (far → near). Delay each sheet by ~2 frames: overlap is the whole performance.

ef9f6c7e-e507-421d-b028-2d76f14d0c11_3.title: Cenotaph — Anansi's Net
ef9f6c7e-e507-421d-b028-2d76f14d0c11_3.action: Wet steps glow under wall-lamps; a child appears at the top of the stairs and looks up as the stars knot themselves into Anansi's Net above the bell tower.
keys: empty steps, lamp flicker in reflection
child rises into view at the top step (head first)
pause — weight settles, hand on wall
constellation lines draw star to star (FX)
hold on the child's upturned silhouette

camera.why: from the reflection on the wet stone up past the child to the sky — the move connects ground ritual to constellation

secondary: distant city lights shimmer on the bay
ef9f6c7e-e507-421d-b028-2d76f14d0c11_3.staging: No child exists in the frame — add one in P2 at the top step (scale from the 0.18 m step risers). The left wall is the camera mask.

7fae27c3-7bd0-4f8b-805b-4ccd740595b2_0.title: Atlantis plaza — the city assembles itself
7fae27c3-7bd0-4f8b-805b-4ccd740595b2_0.action: From above, the plaza's rim unfolds inward ring by ring as buildings self-assemble; the crowd surges toward the centre and the central mosaic lights.
keys: outer buildings fold up from the ground (anticipation squash)
inner ring unfolds, crowd starts flowing in

camera.why: the descending crane gives the rooftops (P1) strong parallax against the plaza floor — scale becomes legible as we drop

secondary: dust kicks up at the crowd's edge
7fae27c3-7bd0-4f8b-805b-4ccd740595b2_0.staging: Top-down: 'depth' is height — rooftops are foreground, plaza floor is background. Crowd reads as texture; treat it as a mass, not individuals.
